summary: Parts 6 (vehicle distance), 7 (go-online-capture), 9 (documents + consents) fully tested. 26/26 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend Profile screen renders documents-card with all 7 doc rows + status pills, consents-card with all 5 rows. DL editor sheet opens, saves via offline sync queue, backend persists (verified in MongoDB: DL number KA0120200001234, expires_on = today+30, status→expiring_soon). Consent toggle for location_tracking flips and persists (backend consent_events shows granted=true). Go-online-capture UI path (start-duty gate → platform-btn-uber → /go-online-capture) was NOT exercised via Playwright — inspection + GPS are unavailable in the web preview, and this was called out as acceptable in the review request. All 3 test files landed at /app/backend/tests/. Regression: existing seeded distance at business_date=2026-08-08 returns non-zero km. No new bugs found. Minor UX note: DocumentsCard refresh runs right after enqueue() returns, so on very slow sync the status pill can briefly still show old status before the queued POST lands — data is correct in DB either way.

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping doc-save, sheet closes and refresh() fires immediately, but the /api/documents POST is only queued via useSync().enqueue — the pill can still read 'Missing' for a beat before the sync worker actually flushes and a second refresh happens. Backend data is correct; only the transient UI state is stale. Consider optimistically merging the pending mutation into local state or awaiting the enqueue's returned promise before onClose(true).

The Switch used for consent-toggle-* does not expose aria-checked on web — this makes automated verification of on/off state hard. Backend flip works correctly. Consider adding accessibilityState={{ checked: value }} to Switch.

action_items: Optional polish: DocumentsCard could await the enqueue flush (or optimistically patch local state) so the status pill flips immediately without depending on the next refresh tick.
Optional polish: pass accessibilityState={{ checked }} to the Switch in ConsentsCard so aria-checked is exposed on web (helps E2E / a11y).
No functional fixes needed — Parts 6, 7, 9 all pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1984 lines — approaching maintainability limits. Suggest splitting docs/consents, go-online-capture, and vehicle-distance into their own routers when a natural break happens.

go-online-capture 403 'too_far_from_hub' returns a dict as HTTPException detail which FastAPI serialises as JSON — confirmed working, but note that dict-detail responses cannot be introspected by generic front-end error mappers that assume detail is a string. Consider a Pydantic error model.

success_rate.frontend: Profile screen: 100% (documents-card, consents-card, DL edit, consent toggle all verified). Go-online-capture E2E: SKIPPED (GPS / camera not available in Playwright web preview — allowed by review request).

seed_data_creation: Test fixtures wipe & re-create per-driver documents, consent_events, go_online_captures, and use a synthetic 2099 window for vehicle_pings to avoid colliding with seed data. All test data cleaned up post-run.
